name: Qualities Of Christ
overview: Scripture reveals the qualities of Christ as marked by humility, service, and sacrificial love, exemplified in His invitation to learn from His meek and lowly heart and find rest for our souls. He models servant leadership by giving His life as a ransom and calls His followers to love one another as He has loved them. Christ is also portrayed as the incarnate Word full of grace and truth, the light that guides believers out of darkness, and the good shepherd who lays down His life for His sheep.
